# Period-48 quaternary PP code: exact distance 20

The code [pp-f4-768-192-20-w9](../../codes/pp-quaternary/pp-f4-768-192-20-w9/code.json)
has parameters **[[768,192,20]]**, maximum check weight **9**, maximum column
weight **4**, and a full regular canonical frame of width **30**. The frame
width is an achieved upper bound; its optimum is between 20 and 30.

## Verification

With Python 3.10 or later, from any directory:

```sh
python3 /path/to/regular-logical-frames/verification/even_period_pp/check.py
python3 /path/to/regular-logical-frames/verification/even_period_pp/test_receipts.py
```

The checker reconstructs both binary check matrices and the normalized cofactor
frame directly from the coefficient and exponent arrays. It verifies ranks
288/288, every translated canonical pairing, the weight-20 logical and its
nontriviality, and the reflection exchanging the two CSS sectors. It also
checks that the redundant trace-row presentation used for search preserves
both original check spaces.

All **64** hash partitions completed exclusion through weight **19**, each
covering all **16** translation-root types. Their input, source and executable
hashes match; all report the same 1,780 partition-frontier nodes and digest,
and their owned frontier counts sum to 1,780. The runs visited **394,443,504**
nodes in total, including repeated prefix work. A verified weight-20 logical
gives the matching upper bound. Reflection gives **d_X = d_Z = 20**.

These are records of completed exhaustive executions, with independently
checked algebra and coverage. The quick audit does not revisit every search
node. To compile the frozen C++17 source and repeat the full exclusion as one
unsplit run:

```sh
python3 /path/to/regular-logical-frames/verification/even_period_pp/check.py --replay --seconds 1800
```

An unfinished replay exits 75 and establishes no new lower bound. A completed
replay exits zero. The search completeness, minimum-logical support reduction,
coset pruning, and partition argument are described in [vendor/README.txt](vendor/README.txt).
The receipt tests reject incomplete roots, wrong cutoffs, duplicate shard IDs,
partition mismatches, hash mismatches, and contradictory transcripts.

## Construction and coordinates

The construction uses the cyclic ring F4[t]/(t^48-1), reversing 3-by-8 checks,
disjoint pivots (0,1,2) and (4,5,6), and free columns (3,7). Field labels
0,1,2,3 denote 0,1,omega,omega^2. In the self-dual trace basis (omega,omega^2),
binary coordinate (2*column + component)*48 + position is zero-indexed.
The pivot determinant is 1+t^24+omega^2*t^25. Its square is omega*t^2, an
explicit unit, so no augmentation-only test is needed at this composite period.
Normalization uses omega^2*t^46. The four X seeds weigh (25,25,25,25), and
the four Z seeds weigh (30,25,30,25).

The attaining Z logical has support:

```text
[0,9,93,131,175,216,293,320,345,441,
 490,491,517,531,565,600,648,680,696,728]
```

X seed zero translated by three pairs oddly with it, providing an explicit
nontriviality detector. The support is also checked directly against the
original stabilizer span.

## Execution evidence

The 64 complete shards are audited together; summed process elapsed time is
401.45 seconds. The weight-20 witness and completed weight-19 exclusions establish
the exact distance. Screening bounds in auxiliary inputs are not distance claims.
Receipts are metadata-normalized copies. Executable fingerprints are declared;
portable replay compiles the supplied source. See ../../docs/PACKAGING.md.

records.content:
Exhaustive binary CSS distance exclusion used by the small-PP campaign

Build: c++ -O3 -std=c++17 exact.cpp -o exact
Full run: exact matrix P W seconds --shard 0 1 4 18446744073709551615
Root interval: exact matrix P W seconds root begin end 18446744073709551615
Return codes: 0 completed exclusion; 10 verified nontrivial witness;
75 interrupted/incomplete; 2 invalid input or runtime error.

The input lists n,m,g followed by binary check and stabilizer row supports.
The constructor checks CSS commutation and invariance of both rowspaces under
the specified cyclic translation. Quotient membership is exact binary Gaussian
elimination. Redundant trace-row sums used in this campaign are independently
checked to leave both physical rowspaces unchanged.

Completeness concerns the least-weight nontrivial logical, not the enumeration
of all kernel vectors. If such a minimum word contained a proper nonempty
zero-syndrome subset, either that subset would be a smaller logical, or its
stabilizer removal would leave a smaller logical. Hence no proper subset has
zero syndrome. An anchored search can therefore stop at each zero-syndrome
support. At every other node, an unsatisfied check must meet the remaining
support. Branching on its available qubits covers every possible completion;
ordered branch exclusions avoid duplicates without dropping a completion.

A minimum logical overlaps each stabilizer in at most half that stabilizer's
support: otherwise adding the stabilizer reduces its weight without changing
its class. A growing partial support that violates this inequality cannot be
part of a minimum logical. The syndrome-degree bound and disjoint available-
neighbor packing bounds are also necessary conditions for completion. The
bounded independent-set routine prunes only when it actually finds the required
disjoint family; a failed or budget-limited attempt contributes no bound.

For cyclic translation period P, choose the first occupied binary P-block and
translate one occupied coordinate to its position zero. This yields one root
per binary block; all earlier blocks remain empty. This is a support-order
reduction, not a sector or quotient-code distance assumption. The native engine
checks the requisite cyclic invariance before searching. A reflection verified
on the physical checks exchanges X and Z, transferring a completed sector bound.

All options at the first branch fit in indices [0,64). Disjoint intervals that
partition this range give a complete fixed-root exclusion. Alternatively,
prefix hashing assigns every surviving prefix to one residue modulo the shard
count. Hash collisions affect workload only; every subtree is still assigned.
All single-shard runs have frontier_seen=frontier_owned. Interrupted roots are
not credited; only explicitly completed roots or complete branch intervals are
used by the portable checker.

These records document completed executions of this exhaustive algorithm.
They are not formal, independently checkable node-by-node proof traces. The
portable checker validates physical codes, witnesses, input/source hashes,
rowspace equivalence and completed coverage. --replay runs the engine again.
